semantic.justification: Task0V5WR6 connects the production Calc route to actual ScDocument,ScViewData and ScDocShell owners through shared SfxObjectShell,SfxUndoManager,SfxInterface,SfxViewFrame,dispatcher and command bindings. Controlled React presenters reuse Writer toolbar styles,Tailwind,Lucide and global fonts. The supported slice includes plain scalar/native local-A1 input,recalculation,cancel,selection,name-box navigation,sheet append/switch,typed token-valued undo/redo and bounded browser viewport projection. Compiled formula adoption retains code errors in history;sheet deletion ends formula subscriptions and renumbers source cells. One real model owns cells;browser state contains transient input/geometry only. This is a bounded editable workspace,not full Calc/native parity. TaskFJTKAS connects actual Calc ODS packages and ScDocShell lifecycle/history to shared primary browser storage and Writer autosave policy. Open imports into a separate real ScDocument and adopts it only while request/content generation remain current. Replacement resets actual view/history ownership and ends displaced formula subscriptions. Confirmed Save/SaveAs captures source model,medium,generation and shared SfxUndoSavePosition;later edits remain dirty and stale/failed/closed completions cannot adopt a destination. The first two displayed scalar words in native row-major sheet order name an untitled browser document,matching Writer first-two-word naming;empty documents are excluded. Stored bodies are complete existing ODS packages,not alternate workbook JSON. No recovery UI/storage is introduced. Task2BTWEE connects Calc native OpenFromCalc26204,SaveAs5502 and ExportTo5829 Sfx slots to actual ODS workflows and the shared Writer-style file dialog. Current input commits before file focus;primary autosave flushes before open/copy/import;computer imports use existing ODS candidate loading and collision-resolved browser identity;named copies and browser opens use actual primary IO. Shell Export uses a separate medium and leaves primary identity,modified state,generation and undo-save position unchanged. Shared CommandMenuBar and CommandButton render consumed native File/Edit placements and normalized source labels/shortcuts. Open dialogs make background Calc chrome/grid inert and restore actual grid focus on close. Native slot/placement/resource identities are preserved for consumed commands;this is not complete native menu/UI parity.
